Independent accepted review of the whole rank-four theorem.

contributions: The exact extension in the classical construction is combined with minimal descent to preserve a prescribed minimal interval cover.
The accepted rank-four theorem consequently gives infinitely many finite minimal covers in every rank whenever a four-consecutive-mark subgroup fails IP.
A separate elementary divisibility obstruction explains why an arbitrary-rank coprime-kernel theorem cannot use independence alone.
limits: No proof of the finite conjecture for all ranks.
